principle: Derived tasks must remain hash-bound to reviewed Golden parents and pass structural, source, HOLDOUT-isolation and mutation-quality checks before any response generation or training export.
required_checks: derived source artifact summary is PASS
exactly 8 tasks exist for each derivation mode
exactly 5 tasks derive from each of 8 Golden parents
every parent remains GOLDEN_APPROVED and hash-compatible
every inherited source ref resolves and matches the parent binding
no HOLDOUT task id, implementation or function name appears
repair and review code mutations are syntactically valid
each registered mutation has a concrete contract defect
training_ready remains false until later critic approval

mutation_quality.rule: Each mutation must be demonstrably defective either by a deterministic behavior probe or by a static contract violation when runtime output can coincidentally match.

telemetry_rule: Report only measured counts and elapsed time. Do not claim model improvement, speedup or ETA from corpus review alone.
